title: Exposure Capacity by Tier, Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy
content:
The most a Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy may schedule or rate at each tier is set out in the capacity table. A count at the figure shown is within capacity; a count above it is not.

| Capacity item | 1M | 2M | 3M | 4M | 5M | 10M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most vehicles the umbrella may schedule | 6 | 6 | 8 | 8 | 10 | 12 |
| Most youthful drivers the umbrella may rate | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Most rental dwelling units the umbrella may schedule | 4 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 8 | 10 |
| Most watercraft the umbrella may schedule | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Longest watercraft the umbrella may schedule (feet) | 26 | 26 | 26 | 32 | 32 | 40 |
| Most dwelling units at one rental property the umbrella will extend over | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |

## How the figures are read

- The vehicle, youthful driver, rental unit and watercraft figures are counts across the whole umbrella.
- The watercraft length figure is a length in feet that each scheduled watercraft must not exceed.
- The per-property figure applies to each rental property on its own: no one rental property may have more than 4 dwelling units, on any tier. It stands alongside the whole-umbrella rental unit count; a schedule must satisfy both.

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical counts)

| Tier | Hypothetical exposure | Within capacity? |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Umbrella 2M | 6 vehicles | Yes, 6 is the figure shown |
| Larkspur Umbrella 2M | 7 vehicles | No, above 6 |
| Larkspur Umbrella 3M | one watercraft of 26 feet | Yes |
| Larkspur Umbrella 3M | one watercraft of 28 feet | No, longer than 26 feet |
| Larkspur Umbrella 5M | one rental building of 5 units | No, above 4 units at one property |
| Larkspur Umbrella 5M | two rental buildings of 4 units each | Yes: 8 units in all, 4 at each property |
